units.source_text: 催马乐《樱人》全文：“（男唱）樱人樱人快停船，载我前往看岛田。

en.t: The full text of the saibara song Sakura-bito is: "(The man sings) Sakura-bito, Sakura-bito, quickly stop the boat and take me to see Shimada.

units.source_text: 我种岛田共十区，察看一遍就回来。

en.t: The Shimada fields I planted cover ten plots in all; I will look them over once and then come back.
I will surely be able to return tomorrow morning.

units.source_text: （女唱）口头说话是空言，明朝回来难上难。

en.t: (The woman sings) Words spoken by mouth are empty promises; coming back tomorrow morning will be all but impossible.

units.source_text: 你在那边有妻房，明朝一定不回来，明朝一定不回来。

en.t: You have a wife over there, so tomorrow morning you surely will not come back, surely will not come back.
" Sakura-bito refers to a local person who rows the boat.
